To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) smartphones can be used for capturing the BCG signal, 2) the BCG signal is a reliable indicator of the heart rate, 3) the BCG signals can be used to estimate the ECG signal, and 4) the estimated ECG signals can be compared to empirical data from patients with cardiac abnormalities.
we can use a smartphone as an ultra low-cost medical tricorder that can provide continuous monitoring of the heart activity and detect heart abnormalities at very early stages.
the BCG signal captured by a smartphone can efficiently be used to estimate the heart rate and the ECG signal.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a smartphone application for real time heart monitoring and the investigation of its performance for the early detection of cardiac abnormalities.
the design and implementation of a low-cost medical tricorder that can be used by anyone to continuously monitor their health.
the design of low-cost portable healthcare systems that can provide real-time monitoring of heart activity, which can be used to detect early signs of cardiovascular diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed method is capable of providing real time measurements of the heart rate and the ability to detect abnormalities in the heart rate variability, with the potential to provide early detection of cardiovascular disease, without the need of any medical staff involvement.
the proposed method can provide an easy access to healthcare monitoring and diagnosis at low cost and with minimal staff involvement.
our method can be used to estimate the heart rate in a reliable manner in real time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a low cost and easy to use medical tricorder that is able to measure the mechanical activity of human heart in real time, and can provide clinicians with a rich set of information regarding the mechanical state of the heart.
the Medical Tricorder can provide a real time heart monitoring system, that can detect and analyse heart abnormalities at a fraction of the cost of current medical devices.
we are developing a low-cost, portable and easy-to-use heart monitoring system which is based on the use of smartphone inertial sensors.

smartphone inertial sensors can be exploited as a low cost, portable and ubiquitous medical monitoring device that can be used by the general public to continuously monitor and analyse heart health.
